symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. does.text: For each camera holding EocCameraBehavior and SelectorModeComponent but not ecl::camera::IsInSelectorModeComponent, the system takes the local player's entity and asks its helper (ecl::camera::SelectorModeSystemHelpers::IsInSelectorMode); if the answer is yes it adds the IsInSelectorModeComponent tag.
